Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Microsoft Copilot Studio M365 .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Senior PMT
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.  

  

As a Senior Product Manager\-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data\-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Own the product vision and multi\-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data\-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies  

  

2\. Make trade\-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace\-specific vs. global calibration)
  

  

3\. Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection  

  

4\. Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high\-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms  

  

5\. Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions  

  

6\. Author the long\-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross\-functional stakeholders

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager\-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data\-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the product vision and multi\-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data\-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies
* Make trade\-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace\-specific vs. global calibration)
* Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection
* Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high\-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms
* Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions
* Author the long\-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross\-functional stakeholders


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**

 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**

**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**

**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**

**Required**

jobs.title: Commercial Technology Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Commercial Technology Manager to join our Digital Business Solutions team. In this role, you will support the development, optimization, and performance monitoring of airline digital products and features across web and mobile platforms. Your focus will be on driving data\-informed decisions to enhance customer experience, boost digital conversion, and align product capabilities with commercial business goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Collaborate with Business managers, UX/UI designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather, define, and analyze product requirements.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to uncover trends and insights, particularly related to key airline product features such as booking flows, ancillaries, flight status, online check\-in, and loyalty programs.
* Translate business needs and objectives into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories.
* Monitor, track, and report on product performance using relevant KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, Net Promoter Score, ancillary attachment rates, digital adoption).
* Partner with customer insights and analytics teams to interpret user behavior, identify pain points, and propose actionable improvements.
* Support the development of business cases and value propositions for new initiatives or product enhancements.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge on airline and travel industry trends, with a focus on digital innovation and customer experience best practices.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
* 4–5 years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, or data analytics—preferably within the airline, travel, or e\-commerce industries.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn data into strategic insights.
* Familiarity with airline commercial systems such as Passenger Service Systems (PSS), NDC protocols, and digital booking flows is highly desirable.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum product development environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical and business concepts clearly.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

**Summary**
 This role sits at the core of driving data\-driven, personalized omnichannel engagement and digital marketing transformation across markets. You will lead the implementation, integration, and scale\-up of Customer Data Platform (CDP) as a key catalyst for changing how brands plan, execute, and optimize their digital engagement. Working directly with local marketers, you will modernize omnichannel strategies, redesign customer journeys, and embed test\-and\-learn, analytics, and personalization into everyday ways of working. Core mission is to elevate digital marketing maturity, deliver stronger, more personalized customer experiences, and significantly improve marketing performance across markets.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Work as product lead for CDP with a strong marketing lens: shape the roadmap around high\-value marketing capabilities (advanced segmentation, identity resolution, real\-time triggers, channel orchestration) based on country demand and impact potential.
* Partner with country marketing and omnichannel teams to identify and prioritize high\-impact marketing use cases that drive measurable outcomes (e.g., HCP engagement, adoption, reactivation).

* Build use\-cases so that the countries can design and optimize end\-to\-end omnichannel journeys (email, SMS, in\-app, web, rep\-triggered, media audiences) including triggers, cadence, and content variations to increase engagement, conversion, and retention.

**Essential Requirements**

jobs.title: Services Portfolio Owner
jobs.description:
**General Summary**
 The Services Portfolio Owner will have a technical focus and work with product managers, internal stakeholders, 3rd\-party partners, and customers to gain a thorough understanding of their product and market needs, translating them into feature stories and tasks for development. You will be responsible for turning the product vision into an actionable backlog and advocating the customers’ needs to the development team.
   

  

 The Services Portfolio Owner is responsible for the development backlog, grooming, and acceptance. This individual will execute converting the product vision and roadmap into workable product requirements for engineering to meet product roadmap expectations defined by the Portfolio Manager. This role will report to the Manager, Services Portfolio and will regularly engage with cross\-functional leaders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be well\-versed in agile scrum and comfortable working in all aspects of a multifaceted delivery network. You will demonstrate excellent problem\-solving skills, be self\-motivated and detail\-oriented, and be a good team player. Other duties include prioritization of key backlog items that drive growth and success, developing supporting documentation, and keeping customers and stakeholders informed of the status of the product.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Owns and prioritizes the sprint backlog for assigned platform and technical domains, balancing technical debt, reliability, and roadmap commitments
* Translates platform and technical requirements into well\-defined epics, user stories, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria
* Converts product vision into actionable backlog items that deliver platform enablement, reliability, scalability and technical debt reduction
* Participates in sprint planning, grooming, retrospectives and reviews for assigned technical and platform teams
* Works with Portfolio Management, Engineering leads, architects and security teams to support platform decisions that are technically sound and aligned with product direction
* Communicates platform capability needs to the development team and represents technical requirements in prioritization decisions
* Supports and utilizes technical discovery with Engineering leads and internal platform consumers to inform backlog priorities
* Communicates platform capability releases to internal consumers and Engineering teams in coordination with Product and Technology leadership
* Serves as a subject matter expert for assigned platform and technical domains, supporting Engineering onboarding tooling, and organizational education
* Escalates technical risks, platform dependencies and roadmap gaps to Portfolio leadership proactively
* Maintains regular alignment with the Portfolio Manager and Portfolio Leadership on roadmap priorities, backlog direction, and technical outcomes; raises conflicts between technical demands and roadmap commitments proactively
* Maintains a minimum of two sprints of groomed and estimated backlog at all times for assigned teams.
* Contributes to epic\-level roadmap tracking across quarters in coordination with the Portfolio Manager and/or Manager, Service Solutions for assigned domains
* Participates in pod\-level planning, estimation sessions and steerco readouts as required
* Ability to travel up to 20%


**KEY COMPETENCIES**
* Balance of technical knowledge and business acumen
* Provides updates on backlog health, sprint progress and delivery risks to the Portfolio Manager and/or Manager, Services Portfolio to support roadmap tracking and stakeholder communication
* Customer first mind set
* Backlog execution – prioritizes and manages the sprint backlog in alignment with the product roadmap defined by the Portfolio Manager
* Proactive, self\-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
* High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability
* Ability to assess risks, dependencies and propose mitigation strategies to overcome obstacles
* Skilled in leading meetings, setting agendas, driving decisions, and negotiating.


**REQUIRED Qualifications, EDUCATION, CERTIFICATES And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, preferably in product ownership, project management or business analysis
* At least 1 year of experience in Product Management and/or Product Development
* Established background in launching software services in partnership with Engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development and experience working within an Agile scrum team environment


**PREFERRED Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare IT, supply chain, or SaaS environments
* Familiarity with B2B integration or EDI transaction workflows (e.g., 810, 855, 850 document standards) a plus familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, AI\-assisted product tools, and agile tooling
* Experience in platform and integration\-oriented technical domains, preferably within an operations\-driven environment


**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
   

  

 GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes an…

jobs.title: Category Leader-Seed
jobs.description:
**Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture**
 At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting\-edge biotech, and next\-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on.
   

  

 Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.
   

  

 Looking for candidates with experience in Seed industry ONLY
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Category Manager is responsible for driving portfolio strategy, product lifecycle management, and profitable growth across assigned seed categories. This role serves as a key link between regional and country teams to ensure effective product positioning, successful launches, and strong market execution aligned to business objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive profitable pricing and portfolio strategy for the Seeds category, delivering both short\- and long\-term revenue and margin objectives.
* Develop and execute crop and hybrid\-specific strategies, including segmentation, targeting, and positioning for key markets.
* Identify market opportunities through robust market analysis and customer insights to support growth and expansion plans.
* Build and manage business cases for new product introductions and portfolio optimization initiatives.


**Product Development \& Launch Excellence**
* Partner with regional marketing, R\&D, and regulatory teams to manage product lifecycle and ensure timely product availability and launches.
* Monitor product development and registration timelines (where applicable) to ensure seamless commercialization.
* Develop clear value propositions for new hybrids/varieties based on field data, agronomic advantages, and customer needs.
* Lead go\-to\-market planning and execution for new seed launches, ensuring alignment across cross\-functional teams.


**Marketing Execution**
* Design and support demand plans in collaboration with sales and marketing teams to drive market adoption.
* Work closely with marketing communications and digital teams to design impactful campaigns and product positioning.
* Track and evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimize strategies based on insights and feedback.
* Develop customer engagement and loyalty programs to strengthen brand and product adoption.


**Business Planning \& Performance Management**
* Own the sales and expense planning process for the assigned category, including forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking.
* Collaborate with sales teams to align on targets, execution priorities, and market deployment plans.
* Monitor business performance and take proactive actions to address gaps and drive growth.


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership**
* Act as the central point of contact for category\-related communication across global, regional, and country stakeholders.
* Drive alignment and secure buy\-in for product strategies within the country organization.
* Lead cross\-functional teams (e.g., Product/Portfolio Teams) to ensure integrated planning and execution.


**Supply \& Inventory Management**
* Define and manage inventory strategies in collaboration with supply chain teams to ensure optimal availability while minimizing excess.
* Align country\-level demand plans with regional and global supply strategies.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred).


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in marketing, product management, or portfolio management within seeds/agri\-inputs or related industries.
* Proven track record of driving growth through strategic marketing and execution excellence.
* Hands\-on experience in product launches and lifecycle management within the Seeds or Agri domain.
* Strong understanding of farmer/customer needs, market dynamics, and channel ecosystems.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong strategic thinking and analytical capability
* Deep understanding of seed business, crop cycles, and agronomic value drivers
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to translate data and insights into actionable business strategies


*Corteva announced to separate our current advanced seed and genetics business to establish a standalone company, operating as Vylor, Inc. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to legal requirements and board approval. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the separation, you would be an employee of Vylor, Inc. and your employment would be governed by Vylor, Inc. employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Vylor, Inc. at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.*

 This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills. jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.
   

  

 This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end\-to\-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.

* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

The Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate plays a crucial role in the Loans group, responsible for delivering on key operational tasks and driving excellence. jobs.title: Loan Servicing Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Loan Servicing \& Credit Support Manager is a pivotal role within our Loans group, essential to the seamless operation of our banking office. This position offers the opportunity to engage with multiple facets of banking operations while executing critical tasks and requirements. Join us to make a significant impact and gain valuable exposure in the financial industry

**Job Summary**


As a Loan Servicing \& Credit Support Manager in our Loans group, you will oversee daily team activities to ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). You will supervise processes such as Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, Pre\-payments, Funding, Rate\-Fixings, Fees, and external payments. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop your skills in managing Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation while making a significant impact on our operations.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Monitor the team daily to ensure all SLAs are met and escalate exceptions for resolution.
* Supervise processes including Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, and Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation.
* Ensure adherence to quality and quantity SLAs with a robust workflow model.
* Serve as the SME, handling complex queries and routing them to onshore teams if needed.
* Implement a Knowledge Management model with SOP maintenance and training.
* Drive 100% compliance with process policies, guidelines, and controls.
* Motivate and support team members to achieve their goals and identify high\-potential employees.
* Identify alternatives and options for addressing issues and exploring scenarios.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues, leveraging diverse skills to achieve goals.
* Identify training needs for process and soft skills to enhance performance.
* Ensure team depth with trained backups for critical work queues.




**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Hold a bachelor's degree with at least 10\+ years of relevant experience in loan servicing or credit support within syndicated loans or the financial industry.
* Possess knowledge of loan systems like Loan IQ.
* Demonstrate expertise in nostro/cash matching, General Ledger reconciliation, and SWIFT/remittance systems.
* Exhibit strong problem\-solving and investigative skills to analyze and resolve process\-related issues.
* Maintain a strong risk and control mindset.
* Understand investment banking products, including loans.
* Drive projects effectively, showcasing strong people, performance, and escalation management skills.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Influence and lead conversations effectively with stakeholders.
* Demonstrate executive presence by summarizing, recommending, and presenting issues and solutions to senior management.
* Cultivate strong interpersonal and communication skills for domain learning.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to challenges.
* Understand product lifecycle and area product management.
* Collaborate across teams to drive process improvements and operational excellence.
* Exhibit adaptability and leadership in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



 Senior Product Managers at Blink are innovators, craftspeople and business thinkers. Your job as a Sr Product Manager is to take ownership over our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and \- above all \- make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.  
 



 At Blink, we determine the specific focus of product roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: our telemedicine platform; our home delivery experience; our growth team; our core cloud pharmacy platform; new product line development and strategic platforms. We’ll work with you to find the right fit. All PM roles include driving product strategy, roadmapping, rapid testing and research, release planning, experimentation and analysis. PMs are expected to become true experts in pharmacy systems \- so that we can transform them. And they are expected to become experts in our customers \- so that we can provide a truly unparalleled experience to them.
 



 While this role is based in India, you will work on global products that require partnership with teams across regions. We are also aggressively growing our teams in India and this role will be one of our founding product based roles here.
 



**About You** 



* Experienced \- you have 6\+ years as a product manager, either with strong consumer or deep platform experience.
* Proven Builder \- you have delivered multiple successful and innovative products from ‘0 to 1 to n’. You can point directly to growth/engagement/success metrics on these products.
* Consumer\-Obsessed \- you always think first about the consumer, hunt for empathy, and do everything possible to give the customer the best possible experience.
* Analytical \- you naturally break hard problems into their pieces, are deeply familiar with best\-in\-class experimentation practices, use key results to drive strategies, and basically just measure everything.
* Driven and Biased\-to\-Action \- you can manage through complexity, lead with influence, make hard decisions, and persevere when things are challenging. You are hungry to win and you have the grit to make it happen.
* Collaborative and Communicative \- you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class\-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
* Technical \- an engineering background/skills are highly preferred for Product roles at Blink. You will work closely with engineering teams and will need to appreciate technical nuances of the solutions being built.
* BE/B Tech degree from top institution; MBA or Computer Science degree preferred but not mandatory.



**Why Join Us:**
 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

**About Us**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
   

  

 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in\-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product.  You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. * Be at the forefront of building a scalable marketplace ecosystem

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

**Overview**
 The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P\&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross\-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high\-impact products that meet business objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute 5\-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P\&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value\-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross\-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs


**KPIs**
* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on\-time, in\-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross\-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.

jobs.description:
**About the Job** 




**Experience Required:** 
 4\-5 years of overall professional experience, including 2\-3 years in a product\-facing role (Product Manager, Associate PM, Product Analyst, or similar). Prior B2B/enterprise product experience is a plus.
 



**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a versatile, product\-minded professional to join our AI product team. This role blends light program operations with substantial product responsibility. You’ll help ensure execution runs smoothly day\-to\-day, but your primary focus will be developing product judgment: understanding users, defining what to build, and using data to make decisions. Over time, your scope will grow into full ownership of product areas within our AI offerings, with mentorship and support along the way.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner closely with product leadership to understand customer needs, market context, and the unique considerations of building AI\-driven products
* Help define and refine product requirements, working with design and engineering to translate ideas into shippable features
* Own analytics for assigned product areas : defining success metrics, building dashboards, and using data to identify opportunities and risks
* Evaluate AI/model behavior from a product lens : understanding accuracy, edge cases, customer trust, and where the product needs guardrails or improvements
* Conduct or support user/customer research, gather feedback, and synthesize insights into actionable product decisions
* Help prioritize the roadmap using frameworks like RICE or JTBD, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business goals
* Collaborate with sales, customer success, and account teams (where relevant) to understand client pain points and translate them into product requirements
* Maintain light program coordination as needed : tracking key deliverables, flagging risks, and keeping cross\-functional stakeholders aligned
* Take ownership of product areas or features with increasing autonomy as scope expands
* Stay current on AI product trends, competitor offerings, and emerging best practices in building with AI/ML



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 4\-5 years of overall professional experience, with 2\-3 years specifically in product management or product\-adjacent roles
* Strong analytical mindset, comfortable with data, spreadsheets, SQL, and drawing insights from numbers
* Technical fluency: able to understand AI/ML systems, read technical docs, and communicate credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Demonstrated product thinking \- track record of defining requirements, prioritizing roadmaps, and making tradeoffs
* Genuine interest in AI products specifically, curiosity about how models behave, where they fail, and how to design around those limitations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mentality \- proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, doesn't wait to be told what to do



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience in B2B/enterprise product management : understanding of multiple stakeholders, longer sales cycles, and enterprise requirements (security, compliance, integrations, etc.)
* Prior exposure to analytics or product tools (Looker, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, etc.)
* Experience or projects related to AI/ML products specifically
* Experience in a startup or fast\-paced environment requiring wearing multiple hats
* Familiarity with product management frameworks (e.g., JTBD, RICE prioritization)



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Someone with solid product fundamentals who's excited to specialize in the AI space which means understanding not just "what users want" but "what's possible and trustworthy with AI today." B2B experience is a strong plus, but we care most about product judgment and analytical rigor.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

  

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.


Labcorp is seeking a **QA Engineer – Salesforce \& Enterprise Applications** to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

**Work Schedule**: This is an initial **one\-year contract position**, and the role is assigned to a **second\-shift schedule**. with standard business hours of **Monday through Friday, 12\.30 PM IST – 9\.30 PM IST** in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable.
* Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior.

**Technical Oversight**

* Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation.
* Perform rigorous functional, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems.
* Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization.

* Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling.
* Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer.
* 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
* 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications.
* 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and negative testing.
* 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably **Copado Robotic Testing**, or similar enterprise test automation tools.
* 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large\-scale data validation testing.
* 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
* 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version\-control practices.

**Certifications**

* Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

**Additional Job Standards**

* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills with attention to detail.
* Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect\-management, and communication skills.
* Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English.
* Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins.
* Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high\-quality solutions.
* Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams.
* Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Manager / Associate Product Manager**
**Turn messy real\-world problems into simple products.**
 AbleCredit builds software for complex enterprise workflows where AI, APIs, business rules, human decisions, and real\-world operations have to work together reliably. We care about building products that work in production \- not just in demos. Our customers don't arrive with clean product requirements. They have operational problems involving people, policies, existing systems, edge cases, and workflows built over years. Product at AbleCredit means understanding that complexity deeply and turning it into reusable, simple product capabilities.
   

  

**What You'll Own?**
* Spend time with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, constraints, and the real problem behind requests.
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering and design from discovery through rollout rather than handing off specifications.
* Prioritize based on customer impact, product strategy, effort, risk, and reuse across customers.
* Define success metrics and evaluate whether shipped products actually improve the workflow.
* Own launches, feedback loops, adoption, and iteration after release.
* Identify patterns across customer requests and turn them into reusable platform capabilities instead of one\-off customizations.
* Maintain clarity on what we are building, why we are building it, and what we deliberately are not building.


**What We're Looking For?**
* 1\-5 years of product, engineering, analytics, consulting, operations, or adjacent experience; level will be calibrated to experience.
* Strong problem decomposition and structured thinking.
* Ability to understand technical systems, APIs, data flows, and constraints well enough to work deeply with engineers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Comfort speaking with customers and asking detailed questions until the underlying workflow is understood.
* Bias toward evidence, prototypes, and shipped outcomes rather than process for its own sake.
* Ability to operate with ambiguity and make sensible trade\-offs.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, workflow products, fintech, or AI\-assisted products.
* Technical background or prior engineering experience.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, analytics, or operational products.
* Experience taking a product from discovery through adoption.


**How Product Works Here?**
 Product managers are expected to understand the problem deeply, not act as ticket routers. The best solution may be a new feature, a platform primitive, a workflow change, an API, or deciding not to build something. Success is measured by customer and product outcomes, not PRD volume.
   

  

 Skills:\- Product Management, Product Discovery, Problem Definition, Requirement Analysis, Problem Decomposition, Structured Thinking, User Research, Customer Research, Customer Workflow Understanding, Product Strategy, Prioritization, User Journey, Workflow Mapping, Product Requirement Documentation, Wireframing, Prototyping, Data\-Driven Decision, Product Metrics, Success Metrics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, A/B Testing, Agile/Scrum, Stakeholder management, Collaboration, Product launch, Adoption, Feedback Loops, Iteration, Enterprise Product Management and Workflow Product Management

jobs.title: Product Lead, Payroll
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The product team owns Rippling’s product direction, defining what to build in order to solve customer problems in a way that allows them to succeed. We do this by intimately understanding the market, our customers, and the perspectives of our key stakeholders and synthesizing that into a product that is effective, efficient, and easy to use.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for owning the success of the Rippling product in India. You will build deep market knowledge and understanding of customer needs, and work closely with design, engineering, legal and compliance to build and with sales, implementation and support to launch and continuously improve the product.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the product vision, roadmap and execution for Rippling in India.
* Conduct market research and customer analysis to understand customer needs and requirements for payroll, HR, and adjacent products in the market
* Deeply understand the legal, compliance, regulatory requirements, and operational payroll flows in each jurisdiction of that country
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, operations, legal, and compliance, to drive execution and ensure you’re shipping successful product with velocity
* Stay close to the data – build a deep understanding of what’s required to hit our ambitious goals


**What You Will Need**
* 6\+ years of Product Management experience
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Owned a successful product from inception to launch
* Relentlessly focused on customers’ needs
* Possess a deep sense of ownership and responsibility and understand that the buck stops with you
* Exceptional interpersonal communication, relationship management, and organizational skills
* Strong critical thinking, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong alignment with our core values: We Run Hard, We Push the Limits of Possible, and Never Not My Problem

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**Position details**

Risk Reporting for Sales \& Trading is a team within the Risk Management Division at MUFG, responsible for delivering risk reports across market risk and counterparty credit risk to key stakeholders on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis. Timely delivery of risk reports to key stakeholders across the first and second lines of defense, as well as senior management, is critical for the management and monitoring of exposures against risk appetite and associated limits. The successful candidate will w ork closely with Risk Managers, Technology, Data Officers and other Risk Reporting team members located across regions to execute risk reporting processes including delivery \& enhancement of existing reports, as well as development of new reports.


Risk reports convey information at various dimensions and levels of granularity including by booking location. Booking locations are in various regions including the Americas, EMEA, APAC (ex\-Japan), and Japan. The Risk Reporting teams are currently organized by region as timely delivery of reports is booking location dependent. This role requires the candidate to work hours which are consistent with the New York time zone. A goal for the Risk Reporting team is to standardize the various regional risk reporting processes into a more uniform global process. This includes process\-timing optimization which may result in more flexible time zone coverage ability over time.


**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will be responsible for market and counterparty credit risk reporting across MUFG’s banking and securities businesses You will:


* Prepare and deliver daily/weekly/monthly market and counterparty credit risk reports
* Migrate existing and develop new reports using PowerBI
* Support risk managers through report analysis and enhancement
* Update policy and procedures relating to market and counterparty credit risk reporting and data processes
* Lead the preparation of ad\-hoc management reports
* Support the execution of strategic initiatives in collaboration with key stakeholders, including development of new reports, as well as enhancement of existing reports

**Job Requirements:**

**Required**

* 2–5 years of experience in a banking, financial services, or other regulated financial institution environment, including risk reporting experience for either market risk or counterparty credit risk
* Basic knowledge of financial markets and products including derivatives
* Strong ability to analyze and interpret data
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, proficient with Excel and VBA
* Detailed technical knowledge of Power BI and other data/reporting tools

**Desirable**

* Understanding of market and counterparty risk exposure measures such as VaR, PFE, Stress Testing
* Detailed technical knowledge of RDBMS (SQL Server or Oracle) and database design methodologies
* Knowledge of additional reporting tools, such as Tableau
* Knowledge of advanced programming languages (Python ,C\#, C\+\+)

**Education / Qualifications** :


Bachelor’s degree preferably in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management or a technical or quantitative discipline


**Personal Requirements**

* Excellent communication skills, with ability to influence diverse stakeholders
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in partnership with other stakeholders; good team player with professional attitude
* Highly motivated and innovative, able to work on own initiative.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex concepts and translate into easy\-to\-understand language, and effectively present in text or slide format
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi\-task in a complex environment with changing priorities
* Excellent accuracy and attention to detail with an analytical mind\-set
* Good time management and ability to prioritize
* Ability to manage large workloads and tight deadlines, balancing urgent tasks and longer\-term projects
* Strong decision\-making skills, the ability to demonstrate sound judgement
* Strong problem\-solving skills

What connects these three dimensions is judgment. The right candidate does not simply execute instructions—they evaluate trade\-offs, apply contextual understanding of the business to shape better outcomes, and use influence to align stakeholders and team members when priorities compete. The individuals this role coordinates are high\-performing subject matter experts delivering enterprise\-level initiatives with direct impact on billing accuracy, CRM integrity, reporting quality, and client operations. The Senior Business Analyst must operate at a level commensurate with that responsibility.
   

  

 This is an onsite role.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Sprint Facilitation and Delivery Orchestration
* Own the end\-to\-end sprint lifecycle across the Salesforce, Data/BI, and Integrations pods, including planning, daily coordination, mid\-sprint adjustments, and retrospectives.
* Drive sprint progress proactively—identify stalled work, surface blockers, and escalate risks before they impact delivery timelines. Delivery is not waiting for updates; it is actively pulling status and intervening when cadence slips.

When a new request threatens an in\-flight commitment, the Senior BA is expected to assess the trade\-off—not defer it—and present options with a recommendation.
* Maintain and prioritize the enterprise work backlog in coordination with the Director, ensuring that user stories are sequenced by business value and delivery readiness.
* Requirements Engineering
* Interface directly with business stakeholders to capture, refine, and document requirements for enterprise\-level initiatives.
* Translate business needs into build\-ready user stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and scope boundaries that pod members can execute against without ambiguity. The quality of requirements directly determines the quality of the output—vague requirements produce rework, and rework consumes capacity the team does not have.
* Challenge stakeholder requests when an ask is impractical, duplicative, or lower\-priority than competing work. This role is expected to deeply understand the business impact of what is being asked, evaluate whether the proposed approach is the right one, and push back constructively when a better path exists. This requires contextual understanding of how the request fits into the broader operational landscape, not just whether it is technically feasible.
* Validate requirements against the operational context of the company’s billing model, CRM workflows, reporting architecture, and integration landscape. Requirements that are technically correct but operationally misaligned still produce the wrong outcome.
* Cross\-Pod Coordination
* Serve as the single point of coordination across CRM, Data/BI, and Integrations pods for initiatives that span multiple functional areas.
* Ensure that dependencies between pods are identified early, communicated clearly, and tracked to resolution. Cross\-pod work is where scope ambiguity, quality gaps, and delivery delays most frequently compound—this role is the line of defense against all three.
